_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja OceansEye/Oko Oceanu (46 terminow, ~14 mikroscen) - OSTATNIA lokacja z kategorii Examine 'lokacje' - przeszklona kopula pod lodzia z widokiem na dno oceanu. Zawiera skrzynie ze skarbem (monety, perly, klejnoty) oraz ostry koral przypominajacy krysztal.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.en: Why [h]is[/h] there an upside-down dome attached to the bottom of the submarine?
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.pl: Czemu do spodu łodzi podwodnej [h]jest[/h] przymocowana odwrócona kopuła?
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.en: I guess it's a bit like a glass-bottom boat.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.pl: Chyba to trochę jak łódź ze szklanym dnem.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.en: So it's just for looking out into the ocean?
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.pl: Więc to tylko po to, żeby patrzeć na ocean?
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_BG/Section d.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ChestStart/S.en:
Hold on.
I'm... just - savoring the moment.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ChestStart/S.pl:
Czekaj.
Ja... po prostu - delektuję się chwilą.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ChestStart/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.en: I guess it was the [h]coral[/h] that's sharp... it's weird, it's like crystal-
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.pl: Chyba to [h]koral[/h] był ostry... to dziwne, jest jak kryształ-
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.en: -I assumed it'd be something weird! Something confusing!
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.pl: -Zakładałem, że to będzie coś dziwnego! Coś zagadkowego!
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.en: Something to turn the case on its head, you know??
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.pl: Coś, co wywróci tę sprawę do góry nogami, wiesz??
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_OceanTreasur.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.en:
Ah - don't touch that door.
It goes... right out into the ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.pl:
Ach - nie dotykaj tych drzwi.
Prowadzą... prosto do oceanu.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.en: I doubt you could open it if you wanted to.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.pl: Wątpię, żebyś mógł je otworzyć, nawet gdybyś chciał.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.en: It's probably pressure locked while the room is drained of water.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.pl: Prawdopodobnie są zablokowane ciśnieniowo, dopóki pokój jest osuszony z wody.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.en: But if the room was full of water...
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.pl: Ale gdyby pokój był pełen wody...
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.en: Then yeah, you could use it to go outside.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.pl: To tak, mógłbyś ich użyć, żeby wyjść na zewnątrz.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_airlockdoor/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_coral/Sectio.en: There's coral growing down here, too.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_coral/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_drain/Sectio.en: That must be how the room fills and empties itself with water.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_drain/Sectio.pl: Tak zapewne ten pokój napełnia się i opróżnia z wody.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_drain/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ladder/Secti.en: It wasn't easy to climb down... but it'll be even harder to climb back up.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ladder/Secti.pl: Zejście nie było łatwe... ale wejście z powrotem będzie jeszcze trudniejsze.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ladder/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ladder/Secti.en: I guess it'd be easier if it was full of water. You know you could just - [i]swim[/i] to the top.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ladder/Secti.pl: Chyba byłoby łatwiej, gdyby było pełne wody. Wiesz, mogłabyś po prostu - [i]popłynąć[/i] na górę.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_ladder/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_rocks/Sectio.en:
Rocks.
Complete with their own barnacles, seaweed and starfish.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_rocks/Sectio.pl:
Skały.
Z własnymi pąklami, wodorostami i rozgwiazdami.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_rocks/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_rocks/Sectio.en: I assumed they were decorative, but they're real.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_rocks/Sectio.pl: Zakładałem, że są ozdobne, ale są prawdziwe.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_rocks/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_sand/Section.en:
Not quite.
It's a bunch of sand on the bottom of the dome.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_sand/Section.pl:
Nie do końca.
To trochę piasku na dnie kopuły.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_sand/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_toplight/Sec.en: I can see the airlock through the hole in the ceiling.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_toplight/Sec.pl: Widzę śluzę przez otwór w suficie.
Examine/Exam_Area_OceansEye_toplight/Sec.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)
